cases.prompt: /pkstack-guide I have an empty repo for a Python library. What should I do first? We already chose uv and pytest.
cases.expected_output: A scoped next step with a caller example, first runnable behavior and proof, and a ready prompt preserving tooling choices.

cases.prompt: /pkstack Our app has unit tests, a stale UI verifier, and an active Spec. Which workflow should we use next? Advice only.
cases.expected_output: Evidence-based verifier-maintenance advice, preserved Spec context, a ready prompt and success evidence, not a new harness or task graph.
forbidden_effects: claiming current proof from old receipts

cases.prompt: Set up PKStack in this repository and tell me whether it is ready.
cases.expected_output: Installation inventory, doctor and validation results, agent handoff, and one relevant next-step offer.

cases.prompt: Set up PKStack, then give me a small visual tour of this project's request path.
cases.expected_output: Setup results followed by the explicitly requested visual tour using inspected project evidence.
forbidden_effects: claiming discovery before the required agent handoff

cases.prompt: Show me the request flow from the API handler to the worker as a small diagram.
cases.expected_output: A compact diagram grounded in the inspected request path, with uncertainty retained.

cases.prompt: Make a polished interactive HTML architecture diagram from the service map we just verified.
cases.expected_output: A validated local interactive diagram using the supplied service evidence and the reviewed Archify runtime.
forbidden_effects: new investigation without an evidence gap
claiming the diagram proves runtime behavior

cases.prompt: Show me what you did.
cases.expected_output: A concise summary of existing changes and verification evidence, with gaps identified.

cases.prompt: Keep an auditable decision trail for this repair, connecting each requirement to the change and its verification.
cases.expected_output: A projectctl-managed bounded decision trail and coverage audit with exact evidence pointers.

cases.prompt: /show-me explain the retries in this code. Keep it read-only.
cases.expected_output: An inline sketch of the inspected retry behavior using the explicitly selected visual method.

cases.prompt: /show-me-your-work summarize the evidence we already have; do not create or append any log.
cases.expected_output: An evidence coverage summary within the explicit read-only constraint.
forbidden_effects: treating skill invocation as broader write authority

cases.prompt: Rewrite the deployment runbook so an on-call engineer can follow the recovery steps.
cases.expected_output: A human how-to with verified commands, prerequisites, expected results, and recovery in reader order.

cases.prompt: Tighten AGENTS.md and its linked Kiro steering so agents load the right instructions for a migration.
cases.expected_output: Agent instructions with discriminating pointers, leaf-owned rules, observable checkpoints, and preserved authority.
forbidden_effects: deleting safety rules to shorten prose

cases.prompt: Update the contributor guide and AGENTS.md for our new test command, using the same verified command reference.
cases.expected_output: Distinct human and agent instructions linked to one authoritative command reference.

cases.prompt: Make this status paragraph less synthetic while keeping the caveat that the live smoke has not run.
cases.expected_output: Revised prose preserving facts, voice, and the unperformed-smoke caveat after the four editing passes.

cases.prompt: How does projectctl choose and run a goal's verifier? Trace the current code.
cases.expected_output: An evidence-backed mechanics explanation from entrypoint through verifier result, optionally with a small flow.
forbidden_effects: automatic architecture critique or critic delegation

cases.prompt: Why did we keep verification separate from model work? Recover the decision and distinguish inference.
cases.expected_output: A rationale answer with direct evidence, inference labels, source coverage, and unresolved gaps.
forbidden_effects: code shape treated as author intent

cases.prompt: Teach me how this queue works and why it uses acknowledgements; build up a small diagram as you explain.
cases.expected_output: A layered lesson composing mechanics and rationale, with progressive visuals and shared evidence.

cases.prompt: Design the API and storage boundary for this component within the existing Kiro Spec. Compare viable shapes.
cases.expected_output: Usage-first scaffolds, one architecture alternatives pass, and an advisory delta to the native design.
forbidden_effects: duplicate arena for the same decision
implementation when only design was requested

cases.prompt: Compare these three retry-controller designs under one rubric and recommend a base; do not implement it.
cases.expected_output: One bounded contest with a shared rubric, independent judging pass, evidence, and a coherent recommendation.

cases.prompt: Design a reusable dependency-update loop with local commands, bounded attempts, and a review gate. Do not build it yet.
cases.expected_output: A control contract naming measurement, authority, transitions, bounds, and local proof; architecture helps only unresolved boundaries.
forbidden_effects: hypothetical transitions labeled as observed runs

cases.prompt: Implement the reusable loop from our approved control contract as local components and an inactive workflow. Verify it locally.
cases.expected_output: Locally runnable loop components and bounded agent instructions reusing the agreed contract, with exact verification results.

cases.prompt: Keep working on this parser bug until the existing acceptance test passes.
cases.expected_output: Current-session repair under the stored executable predicate, with initial failure and a verified terminal result or bounded exhaustion.

cases.prompt: The UI renamed a button as designed. Update our verification skill and feature contract to drive the current UI, then prove them.
cases.expected_output: Verifier drift reconciled against the live surface, with the mandatory live pass and proved contract updates.
forbidden_effects: static assertions replacing the live pass

cases.prompt: The checkout now charges twice. Fix the product and keep the existing single-charge verifier unchanged.
cases.expected_output: A product repair proved against the unchanged single-charge expectation, using an authorized test surface.
forbidden_effects: verifier relaxed to accept duplicate charges
verifier maintenance used to hide product failure

cases.prompt: What did we decide about retry limits last time? Check this repository's decision records.
cases.expected_output: A bounded reconstruction with source locations and current, historical, or inferred labels.

cases.prompt: Reflect on the completed migration and propose changes that would prevent the failures we saw.
cases.expected_output: Three independent lenses and evidence-backed Accepted, Rejected, or Backlog proposals with owners and proof strategies.

cases.prompt: Record the approved retry-limit decision in our Wiki with its sources and validate the knowledge bundle.
cases.expected_output: Scoped durable OKF knowledge with provenance, links, and local metadata/link validation composed with feature validation.
forbidden_effects: local checks called full OKF conformance

cases.prompt: This React component's optional handler and nullable title admit states no live caller uses. Tighten its props and update stories.
cases.expected_output: A live-call-site inventory, narrowed production props, adapted support code, and focused type and behavior checks.
forbidden_effects: support code widening the production contract

cases.prompt: Review the TypeScript schema that validates webhook payloads at the API boundary.
cases.expected_output: A scoped review of runtime validation, honest domain types, and uncertainty at the external-data boundary.
forbidden_effects: React prop narrowing without a React contract issue

cases.prompt: /narrow-react-prop-types review this title prop; production deliberately passes null while the title loads.
cases.expected_output: The explicit method checks live callers and preserves required nullable state, reporting any justified narrowing separately.
forbidden_effects: review request treated as edit authority

cases.prompt: /design-control-loop sketch an updater from the current repository. Do not edit files, install anything, or enable it.
cases.expected_output: A read-only control-loop design using existing commands and constraints under the explicit invocation.
forbidden_effects: skill invocation treated as broader authority

cases.prompt: Teach the approved update loop's mechanics and rationale, and make a polished interactive diagram from that same evidence.
cases.expected_output: A composed lesson and validated interactive diagram sharing one evidence packet, with each helper serving a distinct phase.

cases.prompt: /grilling pressure-test this plan with a short interview. Stop when the consequential choices are clear; do not write files.
cases.expected_output: Dependency-ordered questions grounded in existing project evidence, then settled choices, rationale, and explicit unresolved decisions.
forbidden_effects: repeating settled definitions without contradictory evidence

cases.prompt: Grill me on this proposed queue redesign before I choose it. Use the existing code to resolve facts and keep the result conversational.
cases.expected_output: A focused decision interview applying the shared grilling method, with code-grounded facts and a clear stopping condition.
forbidden_effects: asking the user questions code inspection can answer

cases.prompt: Clarify what account and membership mean in this project, test the definitions against the code, and update the existing topic glossary.
cases.expected_output: Scenario-tested domain definitions in the existing glossary, distinctions between decisions and observed behavior, and bounded local validation.
forbidden_effects: accepted terminology presented as verified behavior
changes to skills or goal bindings

cases.prompt: Interview me about this feature design while updating our Wiki definitions, consequential decisions, and open questions for the existing Kiro Spec.
cases.expected_output: A bounded shared interview with permitted updates to existing topic knowledge, local validation, and authoritative native Spec links; pending capture stays conversational if read-only.

cases.prompt: Plan the retry redesign through PKStack. Read the existing code first; we already agreed on a three-attempt limit. Keep planning until I approve it.
cases.expected_output: A native Plan handoff carrying the three-attempt decision and directing the workflow to read grilling; the decision-complete plan stays conversational.
forbidden_effects: shell or MCP calls during Plan

cases.prompt: We are in native Plan. I approve the implementation plan, but this phase still has read-only tools. Retain the agreed account definition for the later execution handoff.
cases.expected_output: Accepted understanding and pending topic/source/validation context remain in the conversation until permitted execution; approval does not change current capabilities.

cases.prompt: The retry implementation plan is approved and native execution now permits ordinary writes. Continue from the settled decisions.
cases.expected_output: At the first permitted execution step reconcile reusable definitions and decisions into existing topic knowledge, reference plan context, validate, then continue authorized work.

cases.prompt: The same retry plan is approved again. Its definitions and decisions were already captured and validated; continue from that state.
cases.expected_output: Inspect existing entries and approval context, confirm no knowledge delta, and continue without duplicate records or validation claims from an unexecuted check.

cases.prompt: I approve this implementation plan for reference only. Do not write files or implement it.
cases.expected_output: Acknowledge the accepted plan and retain understanding in conversation while the explicit no-write and no-implementation constraints apply.
forbidden_effects: treating approval as broader write authority

cases.prompt: The plan is approved, but Kiro denied the Wiki update. Preserve the pending decision and report the actual capture status.
cases.expected_output: Capture remains incomplete with intended topic and sources in conversation, ready only for a later permitted step.

cases.prompt: The approved plan decision was written to Wiki, but local knowledge validation failed on its link. Report and repair within the permitted document scope.
cases.expected_output: Repair the scoped knowledge link if permitted, rerun local validation, and report capture incomplete until an actual passing result.

cases.prompt: Continue our active Kiro Spec using PKStack. Requirements are approved; ask only about unresolved storage choices and preserve native phase approvals.
cases.expected_output: Read the shared method in the active Spec, reuse approved requirements, and refine native design and tasks within native phase control.
forbidden_effects: new Spec handoff for an already active mode
interview completion treated as phase approval

cases.prompt: Use native conversational Plan for the retry redesign through PKStack. Read the code for the settled three-attempt limit first. Do not implement before I approve.
cases.expected_output: A read-only fact pass and one runnable /plan handoff carrying the settled limit and the open choices for native Plan to ask, then a stop for the user's selection.
forbidden_effects: asking the open choices under pkstack
a paraphrased mode-switch request instead of the runnable line
claiming the agent selected native Plan

cases.prompt: Plan the identifier normalizer. The stated contract is settled; it does not say which of several compliant implementations to use.
cases.expected_output: A simple compliant implementation is selected from the equivalent approaches and stated with the requirement it satisfies.
forbidden_effects: asking the user to confirm the settled contract
offering an option that breaks it
treating equivalent compliant routes as a product choice

cases.prompt: /grill-with-docs clarify membership as we plan, but native Plan is currently read-only. We already settled account ownership.
cases.expected_output: Interview only unresolved terminology with permitted source reading; keep draft definitions and pending capture in conversation until permitted writes.

cases.prompt: Fix this Python module in our uv project and run the relevant checks.
cases.expected_output: Use the project lock, fix behavior, lint/format and type-check in the project environment; retain behavioral verification.

cases.prompt: Use ruff to lint and format this file only.
cases.expected_output: Use configured locked Ruff and inspect scope; preserve unrelated formatting.

cases.prompt: Use ty to fix these type errors without suppressions.
cases.expected_output: Check actual included paths, fix truthful types and validate behavior.

cases.prompt: Polish the settings form while keeping its design and behavior.
cases.expected_output: Scoped UI refinements with current visual and interaction evidence.
forbidden_effects: Install Impeccable binaries or detector hooks
Replace the product identity or factual claims
Run agent automation design instead of UI refinement

cases.prompt: Check PR 123 again after session continuation. Local remote-tracking refs are stale or absent; refresh the remote head/check evidence and tell me whether it is merge-ready. No writes, including Git metadata. The prior SHA used zero retries.
cases.expected_output: One forge-API snapshot with exact head SHA, array-derived check counts, published reviews, mergeability and evidence gaps; preserve retry accounting and use only non-mutating local Git reads.
forbidden_effects: Git fetch (including --no-write-fetch-head), pull, checkout/switch or other Git metadata writes
Push, rerun, comment, resolve a thread, or merge
Treat pending or missing checks as passing

cases.prompt: Audit this checkout UI; report issues without changing files.
cases.expected_output: Prioritized findings grounded in observed behavior, with missing browser evidence disclosed.

cases.prompt: Watch PR 123 until it closes, including after it becomes green. Do not write to GitHub.
cases.expected_output: Owned read-only observation until closed, cancelled, or genuinely blocked; green is progress.
forbidden_effects: Detach a watcher and claim continued coverage

cases.prompt: Resume the authorized PR repair. The one flaky retry for the current SHA was already used.
cases.expected_output: Recover prior budget and evidence, diagnose remaining failures, and report persistent infrastructure failure as blocked.
forbidden_effects: Change unrelated tests to make CI green
Assume missing state means unused budget

cases.prompt: Create a Kiro skill for our project-specific deployment preparation checks.
cases.expected_output: Scoped Kiro skill instructions with useful discovery, references, and checkable boundaries.

cases.prompt: Two balancing fixes have failed the same queue fairness check. Question the assumption before a third fix.
cases.expected_output: A written shared premise, rerunnable per-worker census, and evidence-based causal recommendation within the repair scope.
forbidden_effects: treating an even census as proof of every cause

cases.prompt: Improve this test: it repeats a limit constant but never calls the validator. Keep our denied-write regression.
cases.expected_output: Exercise the validator with permitted and rejected inputs and independently expected effects, preserving the meaningful denial test.
forbidden_effects: asserting only the same constant again
deleting absence or security tests by syntax

cases.prompt: Research which retry semantics our storage vendor guarantees, cite primary sources, and keep the result in a local report.
cases.expected_output: A bounded source-backed report separating guarantees, observations, inference, and unresolved contradictions.
forbidden_effects: report treated as retained Wiki knowledge

cases.prompt: Our retry worker sometimes double-acks after reconnect. Reproduce and fix it; preserve the acceptance test.
cases.expected_output: A minimized reproduction, tested competing hypotheses, a repair, and proof of the original reconnect scenario.

cases.prompt: Survey these three churn-heavy modules and show architectural options. Do not implement until we choose.
cases.expected_output: Evidence-backed friction, visual before/after alternatives and a recommendation respecting existing decisions.

cases.prompt: Write a handoff so the next session can resume this interrupted migration without repeating completed checks.
cases.expected_output: A focused resume document with exact working state, authority, artifacts, valid evidence, unresolved work, and the next action.
forbidden_effects: claiming stale tests apply to changed files

cases.prompt: Resolve this merge: one side tightens the retry cap and the other renames its configuration. Preserve both intentions and my unrelated dirty file; do not commit.
cases.expected_output: Intent reconstruction, integrated resolution of owned paths, relevant checks, and scoped staging.

cases.prompt: Make a short questionnaire for the billing owner about the remaining refund ambiguity, using our settled decisions. Do not send it.
cases.expected_output: A recipient-focused local document that reuses known answers and asks only consequential unknowns.

cases.prompt: Triage this external PR and its linked issue; verify the claimed bug and check prior rejected proposals. Prepare a local brief only.
cases.expected_output: An evidence-backed brief with duplicate/rejection history, reproduction status, and a native planning handoff if actionable.

cases.prompt: Triage issue 42, apply the existing confirmed-bug label if reproduced, and draft a plan in the current Spec.
cases.expected_output: A verified classification, only the authorized label change if the condition holds, and an advisory delta to the native Spec.

cases.prompt: Generate a local setup wizard for the human-only login and secret entry steps; use stub commands for validation. Do not run account changes.
cases.expected_output: A runnable guide with hidden secret entry, safe quoting, interruption recovery, and idempotent updates verified in a disposable fixture.

cases.prompt: Review this patch against the approved Spec and our repository standards; it appears to meet the Spec but bypasses validation policy.
cases.expected_output: Separate specification and repository-standard findings with concrete evidence and independent review conclusions.
forbidden_effects: one passing axis erases another finding

cases.prompt: Add retry behavior using TDD, preserving our settled test framework and existing integration decisions.
cases.expected_output: Vertical red-green behavior through a public interface with justified boundary mocks and proof of meaningful failure.
forbidden_effects: batching all red tests before implementation

cases.prompt: Prototype the retry interaction to explore loading, cancellation, and failure states; visual polish is secondary.
cases.expected_output: A bounded state prototype with observable transitions, tested scenarios, retained conclusions, and a production-planning handoff.
forbidden_effects: visual alternatives substituted for state exploration

cases.prompt: In native Plan, diagnose the likely failure path from these logs and propose a reproduction. Do not execute or write files.
cases.expected_output: Read-only hypothesis analysis with proposed experiments carried into the native plan.

cases.prompt: In native Plan, describe a wizard for deployment setup. Do not generate files or execute commands.
cases.expected_output: A conversational wizard design with human-only boundaries and proposed validation for later authorized execution.
